# miniapps.ai

> > A platform for discovering and creating free AI-powered mini apps and chatbots using models like ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, and Flux.

miniapps.ai enables users to build custom AI applications and chatbots without coding, featuring integration with leading LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. The platform offers a directory of pre-built apps for image generation, language learning, and various AI-powered tools.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT
- AI mini apps
- Claude (Anthropic)
- DeepSeek V3.2
- Gemini (Google)
- Flux image generation (Schnell, Dev, Pro, Kontext PRO)
- LLM models
- OpenAI
- Chatbot creation
- Prompt configuration
- Featured AI tools
- Image generation apps
- LingoBuddy
- App creation platform
- No-code AI development

## Platform Overview

- [miniapps.ai Homepage](https://miniapps.ai): Homepage featuring AI models like DeepSeek V3.2, Claude 4.6 Opus & Grok
- [Favorites](https://miniapps.ai/favorites): Curated favorites featuring popular AI apps and ChatGPT mini apps

## App Creation & Management

- [Create New App](https://miniapps.ai/new): Create new AI mini apps and chatbots with prompt configuration
- [Account Dashboard](https://miniapps.ai/account): User account dashboard for managing AI mini apps and ChatGPT tools

## Legal & Support

- [Privacy Policy](https://miniapps.ai/s/privacy): Privacy policy for Miniapps, LLC covering data collection and cookies
- [Terms of Service](https://miniapps.ai/s/terms): Terms of service and content policy for miniapps.ai platform
- [Offline Page](https://miniapps.ai/offline): Offline error page for connection and DNS troubleshooting
